cases.title: 真人书记舞：替换为 Sam Altman
cases.dataset: 用户提供的历史真人舞蹈源片
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: Sam Altman as shown in <Picture 1>; use this portrait only for identity and clothing, with pose and actions from <Video 1>.
<Video 1>: The complete source video to edit and the reference for all original motion.
summary:
[video editing] Replace only the main performer in <Video 1> with Sam Altman from <Picture 1>. Preserve his recognizable facial features, short thick tousled brown hair, clean-shaven face and light gray long-sleeved crew-neck knit sweater. Complete the outfit with dark trousers and dark shoes. Use realistic adult male body proportions, adapted to the complete original performance. Preserve every original action, hand gesture, expression timing, action order, speed and rhythm. Preserve the original room, furniture, objects, background, camera, composition and original borders. Use the portrait only for appearance; do not copy its static seated pose, yellow chair, tabletop, cup or background. Keep a realistic live-action appearance.
retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: Preserve all original motion, action timing, camera, room, objects and background; replace only the main performer's identity and outfit as requested.
detailed_description:
Preserve the original source actions, their order, timing and rhythm. Keep the source playback speed, camera and duration.
overall_soundscape:
No speech or added sound effects are requested.
non_diegetic_music:
None.
cases.prompt_source_label: 历史 Sam 人像参考＋真人舞蹈编辑的实际提交 prompt；非 IVEBench 官方指令。

cases.title: 外观编辑 — 给饮酒男子戴眼镜
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for the target video edit and supplies its composition, camera, and temporal structure.
Source caption: Two men are sitting at a table in a diner, one of them is drinking a beer and the other is listening attentively.
<Subject 1> is the man drinking a beer in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the other man listening attentively in <Video 1>.
<Subject 3> is the diner scene and table in <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.
Add a pair of glasses to the man.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - Add glasses as requested; preserve the source person's other appearance and actions.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the other source person and his actions.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - Preserve the source scene, table, and objects.
<Video 1> (composition, camera, and temporal structure): fully_preserved - Preserve the source framing, camera motion, cuts, and action timing.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Two men are sitting at a table in a diner, one of them is drinking a beer and the other is listening attentively, and one of the men is wearing a pair of glasses.
The two men are <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>, and the setting is <Subject 3>, as shown in <Video 1>.

overall_soundscape:
The benchmark specifies no audio edit.

non_diegetic_music:
The benchmark specifies no music edit.
task_checks: 仅左侧拿酒瓶男子添加眼镜
另一男子、场景、构图与饮酒链保留
event_rules: 先核编辑完成、人物和场景，再比较同一动作事件。
沿用历史事件定义及区间，缺失事件记 null，所有相邻阶段均保留。
Sam 的既有 arm_direction lag 是离线姿态窗口诊断，不是人工事件起止标注。
失败编辑、缺失动作和负时序结果均保留。

sigma_spans.meaning: sum(abs(sigma[i+1]-sigma[i])) over the active steps; not equal intervention strength.
sigma_spans.note_zh: 前三个方案均启用九步，但 Euler 积分覆盖的 sigma 跨度不同；全局弱引导启用全部二十步。
